shots.focal_element: White king in the centre of the board, surrounded by black pieces, shattering into fragments
shots.transition_other: not visible in the 2 fps sheet; cut from the s006 low-angle wide to a tighter board-level angle
shots.what_happens: Board-level close shot on the green side: Oscar's body is a soft blur behind, black pieces (queen, pawn, knight) hem in the white king, and within half a second the king bursts into white porcelain-like shards that scatter across the squares, with motion blur on the flying pieces in the keyframe. The impact SFX (x007) lands on the shatter; this is the 'Oscar wins' payoff.
shots.build_rebuild: Shoot the trapped king at board level with shallow focus, then composite a rigid-body shatter simulation of the king (white shards, motion blur) triggered on an impact sound about 0.2 s into the shot.

shots.focal_element: Duo owl plush rising up behind the white back rank against the pink backdrop
shots.what_happens: Reaction shot of Duo: in the first frame the plush is mid-hop (feet visible, slightly blurred) above the board, by 0:07.5 it has settled lower behind the white rooks and pawns, wide-eyed, with a blurred white knight in the foreground. The 0:08.000 sheet frame already shows Oscar in profile on green, i.e. the cut into s009 falls right at the shot boundary.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a centred eye-level shot of the losing mascot behind its back rank and puppeteer a short hop-and-drop (about 0.5 s) as a stunned reaction before cutting away.

shots.focal_element: Oscar plush, half-lidded and smug, beside the board edge with captured black pieces
shots.what_happens: Medium shot of Oscar against the flat green backdrop, placed right of centre with the corner of the board and black pieces at lower left; he barely moves while the voice-over starts ('Another win for Oscar,' w0-w3), and in the last frame his left hand lifts into frame at the right edge.
shots.build_rebuild: Frame the character medium, slightly right of centre, on a seamless green backdrop with the board corner in the lower-left, and keep the puppet still so the first VO line carries the beat, ending on a small hand raise.

shots.focal_element: Close-up of Oscar's face (sleepy eyes, moustache) as he talks
shots.typography: Only seen in the final, heavily motion-blurred frame: a small all-caps sans label with wide tracking ('ELO PROGRESS') above light-grey axis numbers; too blurred to judge weight reliably. Font guess (low confidence): Duolingo's Din Round/Feather family.
shots.what_happens: Tighter centred close-up of Oscar while he says 'but hey we all have to start somewhere.' (w4-w11); his eyes go from half-lidded to a contented closed-eye blink at 0:12.0 and his mouth opens under the moustache. In the last sheet frame (0:12.5) a white app panel with an 'ELO PROGRESS' chart slides in over him with strong vertical motion blur, bridging into the app-UI shot; a music hit (x008) sits near the end.
shots.build_rebuild: Punch in from the medium to a centred face close-up on the cut, hold for the VO line with a slow blink, then slide a white app-UI panel up over the frame with motion blur in the last ~5 frames as the transition into the UI composite.

shots.shot_type_other: plush photo cut-out composited over a recreated, zoomed-in app UI (course switcher)
shots.focal_element: Oscar cut-out standing between the selected 'Chess' course tile and the 'German' flag tile
shots.transition_other: UI panel slides in over the previous close-up with vertical motion blur (seen at the end of s010)
shots.typography: App-style rounded geometric sans: bold, wide-set numerals coloured per stat in the top bar; course labels in bold title case, dark grey. Font guess (low confidence): Duolingo's Din Round.
shots.what_happens: A big, flat recreation of the Duolingo course switcher: top stat bar (rook icon 1193, flame 12, gem 500, heart cut off), the Chess tile selected with a blue outline and a German flag tile beside it. A sticker-like photo cut-out of Oscar stands in the middle and wobbles/rocks side to side between frames, arms swinging, as VO says 'Experience my genius,' (w12-w14). A chime-like SFX (x009) lands near the start; a thin teal strip appears at the left edge in the last frame.
shots.build_rebuild: Rebuild the app's course-switcher screen as vector UI at about 250% scale, place a background-removed character photo in the centre with a soft drop shadow, and animate it with a looping +/-5 degree rock and small hop while the camera holds still.

shots.shot_type_other: plush photo cut-out composited over a recreated app UI, reframed wider
shots.focal_element: Oscar cut-out over the course switcher, now with full stat bar and the 'ELO PROGRESS' heading peeking at the bottom
shots.transition_other: not a visible cut: the same UI composite reframes slightly wider and lower (detector split within a camera move)
shots.typography: Same app-style rounded sans: bold coloured numerals in the stat bar, bold title-case course labels, and a light-grey all-caps 'ELO PROGRESS' section heading with wide tracking. Font guess (low confidence): Duolingo's Din Round.
shots.what_happens: The UI composite is framed a little wider: the heart counter '5' is now visible top right, a teal app sidebar edge shows at left, and the 'ELO PROGRESS' heading starts to enter at the bottom, so the virtual camera is pulling back / panning down toward the ELO chart. Oscar's cut-out now shows his feet with a soft contact shadow. VO tail 'genius,' (w14) ends here.
shots.build_rebuild: Continue the UI composite with an eased camera move of about 10% pull-out plus a downward pan that reveals the stat-bar heart count and the top of the 'ELO PROGRESS' section, keeping the character cut-out pinned with a contact shadow.
